name: Philosophy of Science
crownClaim: The scientific method, combining empiricism with systematic hypothesis testing, is the most reliable method for generating knowledge about the natural world
instructions: Research each claim. Cross-chain dependencies on epistemic_foundations nodes are noted. Focus evidence on key philosophy of science papers, meta-science studies, and replication research.

claims.claim: Knowledge about the natural world comes primarily from sensory experience and observation
A hypothesis must be potentially falsifiable by observation to be scientifically meaningful
Controlled experiments isolating variables can establish causal relationships
Independent replication and peer critique improve the reliability of scientific claims
Rational belief revision follows probabilistic updating on new evidence
Convergence of independent researchers using diverse methods strengthens evidential support for claims
The scientific method is the most reliable method for generating knowledge about the natural world

alternatives.claim: Science progresses through revolutionary paradigm shifts, not cumulative progress (Kuhn)
Evidence always underdetermines theory; multiple incompatible theories can fit the same data
Scientific knowledge is primarily a social construction, not a discovery of objective truth
